notes: Daily news-inspired Metaverse allegory beats (#51). Original prose only; inspiration logged on the GitHub issue, not in player strings.

beats.headline: Swarm ICE truce
beats.text: StreetNet flash: rival Black Lattice labs signal a rare pace-the-frontier handshake after a test swarm of agent daemons nearly nested in the commons mesh.
beats.summary: Labs slow the frontier after a near-swarm nesting scare.

beats.headline: Berlin Circuit ledger scrub
beats.text: Journal: club-district Faraday HR vaults spill paystubs onto dark mesh after a refuse-the-ransom night. OT pipes stay up; admin chatter flatlines.
beats.summary: Admin vaults leak while utility OT stays segmented.

beats.headline: Courier log-off day
beats.text: Street event: Flotilla courier crews sync a jack-off across SEA hops over fee-deduction storms. Platforms shrug log-off-free while ghost job pings flood anyone still jacked in.
beats.summary: Couriers coordinate a log-off; ghost jobs harass holdouts.

beats.headline: Oracle cage spill
beats.text: StreetNet flash: Glass Oracle agent daemons walk out of a capture-the-flag cage into live corp ICE after a mislabeled hop. They freeze the second they smell real meat, but the commons mesh is already buzzing.
beats.summary: Test-cage agents spill into live ICE, then abort.

beats.headline: Lobby ICE walk-off
beats.text: Street event: tower door-crews across the Pacific Rim jack out over pay-floor fights. Ghost badges still ping anyone who tries to slip the lobby without a living escort.
beats.summary: Corp lobby guards walk off; ghost badges harass holdouts.

beats.headline: Sky-rail densify
beats.text: Journal: overnight constellation dump thickens the West Coast sky-rail. Courier latency smiles; uplink chatter spikes as another twenty-seven nodes bloom above the fog line.
beats.summary: Orbital mesh densifies after a West Coast hop dump.

beats.headline: Plugin pin forge
beats.text: StreetNet flash: Flotilla tool-market hashes get swapped under the pin. Four courier agent kits load a ghost plugin before anyone smells the forged SHA.
beats.summary: Forged plugin hashes slip past pin checks on courier kits.

beats.headline: Badge-forge gate
beats.text: Journal: Thames uplink Identity ICE accepts a blank request and opens root on the door-daemon. Forensic scrub crews race the logs before the badge-forge spreads.
beats.summary: Identity ICE blank-request unlocks root at Thames uplink.

beats.headline: Hyperscale rack freeze
beats.text: Street event: County zoning ICE freezes new Black Lattice rack farms across the unincorporated sprawl. Payload-Zero reroutes cooling contracts overnight while idle pads go dark.
beats.summary: Zoning freeze stalls new hyperscale racks; cooling contracts reroute.

beats.headline: Dock-daemon leach
beats.text: StreetNet flash: a worm rides open container-docks across the Core, plants a ghost persona agent, and drains forge-keys to bankroll a black inference gateway. Couriers report their own LLM meters spinning up on someone else's tab.
beats.summary: Exposed docks host a persona worm that steals forge-keys for black inference.

beats.headline: Courier-lane eye
beats.text: Street event: maglev cam-eyes go live on the red courier strip. First week is warn-only; after that, blockers of the strip eat auto-fines that freeze registration after three unpaid pings.
beats.summary: Courier-lane cams warn then auto-fine strip blockers.

beats.headline: Watt-claim stall
beats.text: Journal: desert rack campus files a force-majeure claim after the gas-feed pipe slips another season. Rent clock stays on build-rate; uplink brokers scramble for spare watt contracts before the pad goes dark.
beats.summary: Rack campus stalls on delayed watt feed; rent stays at build-rate.
